senses.gloss: to order a division, to assign half, divide.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 34a:16">B. Kam. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>פחת שפחתתו מיתה מַחֲצִין בחי</he> Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. <he>שפחתו</he>) half of the loss of value which death has caused, is collected from the living animal; Y. ib. I, end, 2ᶜ <he>מחצין את הנזק</he> the loss is divided.
